blocks.html: Shells or casings for steel cased piles shall be of steel and be sufficiently strong to resist collapse and sufficiently water tight to exclude any foreign materials during the placing of concrete. Steel shells shall have a sealed tip with a diameter of not less than 8 inches (203.2 mm).
